title: fix(plugin-designer): editing an app keeps its stored navigation (objectui#10894)
body:
Fixes #10894
Clause-②: no — an edit stops destroying stored navigation. No declared type, accepted key or published surface moves.

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM loop, claim comment 5864678970, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`. Base `9f0c84a448`, head `5b2b8568bb`.

## What changed

- `AppCreationWizard`: leaving the Objects step (`handleNext`, and `handleStepClick` on the step 1 to step 2 jump) no longer sets `navigation: generateNavFromObjects(prev.objects)`. Both call `mergeNavWithObjects(prev.navigation, prev.objects)`:
  - an EMPTY navigation is filled with one object entry per selected object, exactly what `generateNavFromObjects` returns (the create path, unchanged);
  - a non-empty navigation is merged, never replaced (rule below).
- `EditAppPage`: an object counts as selected when the stored navigation has an object entry for it ANYWHERE, a group's children included (`navObjectNames`, exported from the wizard module). It counted top-level entries only.
- One changeset, `.changeset/10894-app-edit-keeps-navigation.md`: `'@object-ui/plugin-designer': patch`.
- No second navigation model, and nothing regenerates on a step change.

## H1 — reproduced on `main` (`9f0c84a448`)

A throwaway probe (deleted, never committed) drove the real `EditAppPage` and wizard to `saveItem`, renaming the app only. The stored navigation `[nav_accounts (object "Customer Accounts", icon Briefcase), nav_rule (separator), nav_sales (group with the nav_pipeline dashboard child), nav_docs (url)]` saved as:

```json
[{"id":"account","type":"object","label":"Accounts","icon":"Building","objectName":"account"}]
```

The Navigation step listed `["account"]`. Even the kept object entry lost its authored id, label and icon. Create-path control on the same base: an empty draft with `account` and `contact` selected saves the two generated object entries (the control row below, green on base).

## H2 — every writer of `draft.navigation`

All writers live in `AppCreationWizard`:

| Writer | What it writes | Read point |
|---|---|---|
| initial state | `DEFAULT_DRAFT.navigation` (`[]`), then the `initialDraft` spread: `EditAppPage` passes the stored `navigation`; `CreateAppPage` passes a localStorage draft, which can carry one | Navigation step list |
| `addNavItem` | appends a group, url or separator | Navigation step list |
| `removeNavItem` | filters a top-level entry by id | Navigation step list |
| `reorderNavItem` | swaps two top-level entries | Navigation step list |
| `handleNext` (leaving step 1) | was `generateNavFromObjects` (replace); now `mergeNavWithObjects` | Navigation step, then save |
| `handleStepClick` (step 1 to 2) | same as `handleNext` | Navigation step, then save |

The draft's navigation is read by `NavigationBuilderStep` (`items`), by `handleComplete` (`onComplete`, then `wizardDraftToAppSchema`, then `saveItem` in `CreateAppPage` / `EditAppPage`) and by `handleSaveDraft` (localStorage). `EditAppPage` also reads the STORED navigation for the Objects step's `selected`.

`NavigationDesigner` is a controlled component (`items` / `onChange`); the wizard does not render it and it writes nothing to the draft. `apps/console` has no writer: app-shell's `AppContent` lazy-loads `CreateAppPage` / `EditAppPage` onto routes, and the console tests mock `EditAppPage`.

## The merge rule, and the group-child edge

Leaving the Objects step with a non-empty navigation:

- the object entries of an object the Objects step lists as DESELECTED are dropped, at the top level or inside a group;
- a SELECTED object with no object entry anywhere in the tree gets one, appended at the end;
- everything else is kept as stored, in its position: separators, groups and their children, `url` / `dashboard` / `page` / `report` / `component` / `action` entries, each object entry's authored label, icon and order, and an object entry for an object the Objects step does not list (nothing deselected it).

When no entry is dropped the tree is returned as the same array, so an untouched edit saves the stored bytes.

**Group-child edge, measured and pinned.** An object entry the author placed inside a group (`nav_people`, object `contact`, inside `nav_sales` beside the `nav_pipeline` dashboard):

- untouched, it round-trips byte-equal: `EditAppPage` now lists `contact` as selected;
- deselecting `contact` drops the entry from inside the group. The group keeps its place, its label and icon, and its other children;
- a group whose only child is dropped stays, with `children: []`. The spec `AppSchema` parses that save green.

Without the `EditAppPage` change the merge would drop a grouped object entry on an edit that never touched it: ablation B below reddens exactly those rows.

## Pins, red on base and green on head

`packages/plugin-designer/src/__tests__/EditAppPage.keepsNavigation-10894.test.tsx`, 9 rows, each through the real `EditAppPage` or `CreateAppPage` save:

1. the stored tree round-trips byte-equal apart from the edited title, leaving the Objects step by Next (whole body compared as JSON, plus the Navigation step lists the stored entries in order, plus spec `AppSchema` green);
2. the same, leaving the Objects step by the step indicator;
3. selecting a new object appends exactly its entry and keeps everything else;
4. deselecting an object drops only its entry;
5. a grouped object entry round-trips untouched;
6. deselecting its object drops it from inside the group; the group and its other children stay;
7. a group whose only child is dropped stays, with an empty `children`;
8. an object entry whose object the Objects step does not list is kept;
9. CONTROL: the create path still generates one object entry per selected object for an empty draft.

- **Base** (the test-only commit `3b93e01369` on base code): `Tests 8 failed | 1 passed (9)`. The one pass is row 9.
- **Head** `5b2b8568bb`: `Tests 9 passed (9)`.

**Ablation A: restore the unconditional regeneration.** `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack) swapped both `mergeNavWithObjects(prev.navigation, prev.objects)` calls for `generateNavFromObjects(prev.objects)`: anchor x2 to x0, blob `1669c2e50c50` to `adac4d10b62c`. Result `Tests 8 failed | 1 passed (9)`: rows 1 to 8 red, only the create-path control green. Restored: blob equals HEAD (`1669c2e50c50`), `git diff HEAD` empty.

**Ablation B: `EditAppPage` selection back to top-level only.** Anchor x1 to x0, blob `31e1ae7eb312` to `6744ceabdad7`. Result `Tests 3 failed | 6 passed (9)`: exactly rows 5, 6 and 7. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

The pins import `EditAppPage` and `CreateAppPage` by relative path into `src`, so no `dist` sits in the resolution path and neither ablation needed a build leg.

## Consumer sweep

Population: 27 test files under `packages/plugin-designer/src` (`git ls-files` and `find` agree). The five that touch the wizard, `CreateAppPage`, `EditAppPage` or `NavigationDesigner` (git grep for those names and their registry keys), at head `5b2b8568bb`:

## Serial

The claim read the open-PR file lists at `9f0c84a44`: none touches `packages/plugin-designer/src`. Re-read before this PR opened: 10 open PRs, none touches `packages/plugin-designer/src`. The release PR's file list was read as one capped page of 100; it versions packages. PR objectui#10889, the file's previous holder, is merged.

## Acceptance notes

- **"Newly selected" is read as a state, not a delta:** a selected object with no object entry anywhere in the tree gets one. So if an author removes an object's entry on the Navigation step but leaves the object selected, passing through the Objects step again brings the entry back. That matches today's behaviour for that entry, and it keeps the Objects step's ticks meaning "this object is in the navigation". The delta reading ("only objects ticked during this visit") would need the wizard to remember a selection snapshot.
- The wizard's Navigation step still lists and edits top-level entries only. A group's children are kept and saved, but not shown there. This PR leaves that unchanged.
- The create path merges too once the author has shaped the navigation, a localStorage draft included. Going back to the Objects step keeps added separators, groups and links, and their order. The changeset says so.
- An appended entry's id is the object's name, as on the create path. A stored non-object entry already using that exact id would be duplicated. Not measured; no fixture or stored tree read here does it.
- Exporting `navObjectNames` from the wizard module keeps the change inside the claimed file surface. It costs one `react-refresh/only-export-components` warning there (warnings are not a gate). The `EditAppPage` edit removes one `no-explicit-any` warning.
